contexts.goal: Follow these steps to perform this Touchscreen Performance Troubleshooting
contexts.title: Touchscreen input delay

actions.description: It will remove obstructions that interfere properly

steps: Remove the screen protector if it is peeling or has debris under it.

actions.description: It will remove moisture and debris safely

steps: Gently wipe the front and back with a lint-free, soft microfiber cloth or a camera lens cleaning cloth.

actions.description: It will provide sufficient power for operation

steps: Try using a different, undamaged charger.

actions.description: It will improve touch response for screens

steps: Tap the switch next to Touch sensitivity to enable it.

actionableDeeplink.description: Enables touch sensitivity via device Settings on the device.

actions.description: It will prevent overly sensitive screen inputs

steps: Tap the switch next to Touch sensitivity to disable it.

actionableDeeplink.description: Disables touch sensitivity via device Settings on the device.

actions.description: It will stop gestures from misreading taps

steps: Select Buttons to disable full screen gestures.

actionableDeeplink.description: Opens the navigation bar settings page in device Settings on the device.

actions.description: It will provide expert help for issues

steps: Reach out to Samsung Support for further assistance.

actions.description: It will clear temporary system glitches effectively

steps: Press and hold the Power button.

actions.description: It will isolate third party app issues

steps: Press and hold the Power button and the Volume down button at the same time.

actions.description: It will restore device to original state

actionableDeeplink.description: Opens the Factory data reset settings screen
actionableDeeplink.message: Open Factory data reset under General management
